skill_name: Compile a list of 5 online programming languages for kids.
workflow: The 5 best online programming languages for kids are Scratch, Blockly, Python, Ruby on Rails, and JavaScript. Scratch is a visual programming language and online community designed for children to learn programming. Blockly is a visual drag-and-drop programming language designed for children of all ages to use. Python is an interpreted, interactive, object-oriented programming language that is easy to learn and use. Ruby on Rails is a web application framework written in Ruby, which is object-or
